description: Cross-engine conformance cases: one command, one expected result or error. Imported from the suite both reference engines run, then kept here as the canonical executable suite.

option Concepts typed Option through an inline kip://conformance/options package instead of the removed Preference type (Profile §5.5); the fixtures' options remain one partition, as before

revised_on_import.name: until is excluded exactly at the boundary
revised_on_import.change: expected status insufficient instead of rejected: an Assertion outside its effective interval contributes nothing, and rejected is never produced from absent support (Spec §14.3, §21.5)
context-mismatched candidate expects insufficient: functional alone does not imply complete/exclusive-value rejection
policy enumeration/description check kip:memory-default by partial object matching, permitting other deployment policies without requiring private baseline/forecast settings
inferences now cite Evidence and producing Activities with DependencyBasis pins and projection basis captured from actual setup reads; add value-only correction historical coverage
the four DEFINE cases require draft_vocabulary through the request envelope (§71), so an engine without that optional capability skips them instead of failing the case that resolves the draft symbol
verified by both engines at anda-db 6a67d60 and no longer pending_engine; its four DEFINE cases moved to draft-vocabulary.json

new pending fixture (§20.16): the four DEFINE cases of world-time.json plus listing, description, exact draft references, a draft Concept Type, projection over a draft Predicate, same-kind conflicts, required description, unknown and authority-claiming members, MUTATE placement and parameter binding
new pending fixture (§14.2): supersession across context sets fails SupersessionMismatch and writes nothing; a same-scope correction supersedes
new pending fixture (§59.1, Profile §6.1): effective_strength under the standard kip:strength-half-life-30d policy, null for a missing base, anchor or matching pin, and read-only

revised_on_import.name: a projection reports the policy it ran under

four pending review regressions: a Predicate can share a Concept Type name and exact ref; review_schema keys include ConceptType/PredicateType so both reviews are created and retry independently
